_note: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. Every incident description starts with [DEMO] and every demo resource id starts with DEMO-, so demo data is easy to tell apart from live data. Coordinates are invented points in the same synthetic area the app already uses; they are not real emergency locations.

incidents.description: [DEMO] Severe chest pain at the community hall - patient cannot breathe, oxygen needed urgently
incidents.note: Classified high urgency from supplied evidence ('cannot breathe').

incidents.description: [DEMO] Family stranded on a roof after flash flood, need rescue by boat, water rising fast
incidents.note: Assigned to Rescue Team Bravo; later affected by the route closure.

incidents.description: [DEMO] Not urgent: two tents needed at the community centre, no injuries
incidents.note: Explicitly non-urgent report - demonstrates that thin/relaxed reports are not inflated.

offline_sos.description: [DEMO] Child stuck under a collapsed cupboard, leg pinned, cannot move
offline_sos.note: Submitted to the Edge Gateway while it is OFFLINE; queued, survives a gateway restart, then synchronized.

route.name: [DEMO] Harbour Road Corridor
route.note: This corridor crosses the direct path from Rescue Team Bravo to the roof-rescue incident, and only that path.
